question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Unhappiness
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Unhappiness"** means a state of being sad or not satisfied. (असंतोष)

 
 
• **Example:** Her **unhappiness** was evident when she received the bad news.
 
 
 
• **"Woe"** refers to great sorrow or distress. (दुःख)
 
 
• **Example:** His face showed the** woe** he felt after hearing about the tragedy.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wilful** (जिद्दी): Showing a stubborn and determined intention to do as one wants, regardless of the consequences.

 
 
• **Example:** Her wilful nature often leads to conflicts with others.
 
 
 
• **Willing** (इच्छुक): Ready, eager, or prepared to do something.
 
 
• **Example:** He is always willing to help his friends.
 
 
 
• **Wicked** (दुष्ट): Morally wrong and bad.
 
 
• **Example:** The wicked witch in the story cast a spell on the princess.
